beats.narration_text: You've heard you can't know a particle's exact position and speed at the same time.
beats.tts_normalized_text: You've heard you can't know a particle's exact position and speed at the same time.
beats.new_visual_element: a person trying to pin a tiny particle with calipers
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person trying to pin a tiny particle with a pair of calipers]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person frustrated, the tiny particle slipping away from the calipers]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person and calipers draw in, the tiny particle slips away as they try to pin it; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: The usual story blames the measuring device for disturbing it — but that's not the real reason.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The usual story blames the measuring device for disturbing it — but that's not the real reason.
beats.new_visual_element: the person with a measuring tool, shaking their head
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person holding a measuring tool over a particle]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person shaking their head, setting the measuring tool aside]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person and measuring tool draw in, the person shakes their head and sets the tool aside; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Show the particle two ways: where it is, and which wavelengths it's made of.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Show the particle two ways: where it is, and which wavelengths it's made of.
beats.new_visual_element: two linked panels — position (top) and momentum (bottom) — with axes and labels
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a top panel labelled 'position' and a bottom panel labelled 'momentum (wavelengths)', each with a baseline axis

beats.narration_text: A wide, spread-out wave has one clear wavelength, so its momentum is sharp.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A wide, spread-out wave has one clear wavelength, so its momentum is sharp.
beats.new_visual_element: a wide bump in the position panel and a narrow peak in the momentum panel
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a wide Gaussian in the position panel and a narrow Gaussian peak in the momentum panel; indicate the sharp momentum peak

beats.narration_text: But spread out like that, you can barely say where the particle is.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But spread out like that, you can barely say where the particle is.
beats.new_visual_element: the wide position bump highlighted as 'position uncertain'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: indicate the wide position Gaussian with a bracket labelled 'where? uncertain'

beats.narration_text: Now squeeze the wave to pin its position down to a tight spike.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now squeeze the wave to pin its position down to a tight spike.
beats.new_visual_element: the position bump morphs into a narrow spike
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: animate the position Gaussian narrowing to a tall thin spike (width tracker shrinks)

beats.narration_text: Building that spike takes a whole mix of different wavelengths added together.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Building that spike takes a whole mix of different wavelengths added together.
beats.new_visual_element: the momentum panel fans out into a broad spread
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: as the spike forms, the momentum Gaussian widens into a broad low spread; indicate 'many wavelengths'

beats.narration_text: So the momentum panel fans out wide exactly as the position panel narrows.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So the momentum panel fans out wide exactly as the position panel narrows.
beats.new_visual_element: the inverse trade shown — narrow top, wide bottom
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: hold both panels and draw linking brackets — narrow position width vs wide momentum width

beats.narration_text: Pin either one tighter and the other must spread; their product never shrinks past a limit.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Pin either one tighter and the other must spread; their product never shrinks past a limit.
beats.new_visual_element: a see-saw between the two widths + a 'width x width is fixed' label
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: animate the width tracker back toward wide then narrow (see-saw), with a label 'width x width never goes below a limit'

beats.narration_text: No microscope touched it — the trade-off is the wave's own shape, before any measurement.
beats.tts_normalized_text: No microscope touched it — the trade-off is the wave's own shape, before any measurement.
beats.new_visual_element: a red handwritten label 'baked into the wave, before you look'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: settle the panels and write a label in red 'baked into the wave — before you look'; clean close
